title: The Air the Second-Born Held
deck: On the refinery moon Calder, eight hundred engineered workers with no standing have set the air plants to a slow decline, and Illuminara must find a guarantee strong enough that nobody has to hold a breath hostage again, and a standing no council can vote away.
shape: Five days of a countdown; each scene moves one party's line of dependence into the open until the air rests on a lever nobody can pull, and the second-born's standing rests on a record no one on Calder keeps.

scenes.title: The Gate Below Nine
paragraphs: *Lower Level Nine, Ring Gate · Day one, 06:10*
Wren Odira read the numbers off the slate before the lift had finished opening.

**Wren Odira**  
Plant Two is at eighty-two percent of rating and losing two points a day. Oxygen from the tanks covers the gap, but only down to seventy-four. Under that there is not enough reserve to repressurize a deck that takes a breach.

**Illuminara**  
And what the tanks cannot cover?

**Wren Odira**  
The tanks make oxygen. They do not scrub. Level Four read four thousand parts per million of carbon dioxide at midnight. The norm is fifteen hundred.

**Illuminara**  
Who lives on Four?

**Wren Odira**  
The clinic. The nursery. The old. It is the dead end of the ring, so it fills first, and the clinic's last ward sits past the final vent where the air barely moves.

**Illuminara**  
And Plant One?

**Wren Odira**  
Forty-one percent of the colony's air, and the engineers say it cannot be pushed past forty-nine. Plant Two is the rest, and it feeds the lower ring. Kesh Aurelian sequences Plant Two. He said day five, and at two points a day, day five is the line.

The corridor beyond the gate was low and warm and smelled of hot metal and boiled grain. Illuminara stood in it and let AC do what it did. It did not read minds. It made the lines of force in a place visible to her, the way a map makes slope visible, and she saw how the people in the corridor leaned. Every body leaned toward the gate. It was not the lean of hostility. It was the posture of people who had been told, all their lives, to wait.

*That is a reading, and a reading is a guess about someone else's mouth. Test it before you rest on it.* She had been a court interpreter at twenty-four. She had learned that the first meaning always arrives sounding like certainty.
A woman in a grey scrubber-hall coat came out of the crowd and did not offer her hand.

**Marit Voss**  
Marit Voss. I run the day shift on Two. Kesh said you would ask to see him first.

**Illuminara**  
I would like to start with whoever has to breathe the answer.

**Marit Voss**  
That is the wrong answer for a diplomat and I may keep you for it. There are eight hundred of us on this plant. We have run it since before the first of us was born, legally speaking. Come to the hall tonight. They will ask you things. If you answer like a politician nobody opens that door twice.

scenes.title: What the Hall Asked
paragraphs: *Scrubber Hall, Plant Two · Day one, 20:00*

They sat on the maintenance benches among the great grey cylinders, three hundred of them, the rest listening on the relay. The elder, Osei Tamm, had a voice like a worn gasket and did not stand to speak.

**Osei Tamm**  
Ninth Year, the council gave us a charter. Recognition, they called it. We were counted. We were given ration cards with our own names on them. In nineteen months they repealed it. They did not even need a vote against us. A clerk added a column to the census, and we were contract stock again, and the cards stopped working at the canteen. I was forty. I remember the canteen.

**Illuminara**  
And since then, every recognition has been used and then taken back.

**Osei Tamm**  
Every one. Do not say it as if you have learned it from a file. The one thing on this moon they cannot repeal is the air, because it passes through our hands. That is not politics. It is the only fact we have.

**Marit Voss**  
Ask her what you want to ask her, Teodor. You have been holding it all day.
A young man near the back stood up. His hands were scarred across the knuckles from valve work.

**Teodor Rask**  
My sister is on Level Four. First-born husband, a baby. The ring read forty-one hundred when I came off shift, and I turn the dials that are going down. I am not going to tell you I am proud of it. If this ends with a child on Four in a tent, I did that, and Kesh did that, and I do not know what I am if the price of being a person is that.
Nobody spoke. Marit turned toward the room.

**Marit Voss**  
I am not a lever. I want that said in front of her. I want my standing. I do not want it bought with somebody's lungs. If the only way we get it is by being the hand on the throat, then they were right about us and I would rather lose.

**Osei Tamm**  
Then you will lose, Marit. Sit down. Both things are true.
Illuminara waited until the room had finished being angry. Then she said what she had, which was less than they wanted.

**Illuminara**  
I do not know yet how to give you a guarantee that cannot be taken back. I know three things. I know I cannot ask you to trust me. I know the air has been your only leverage and your worst burden. And I know that if I find nothing, I will say so plainly, and you will have lost nothing but two days.

**Osei Tamm**  
Two days. That is an honest sum. Come back when you have something that does not need us to like you.

scenes.title: The Number Behind the Council
paragraphs: *Council Chamber, Upper Ring · Day two, 09:15*
Speaker Ines Torvald had a clipped, tired manner and did not rise either.

**Ines Torvald**  
We do not bargain with hostage-takers. If we do, the next group learns the shape of the key. I will hear you out. I will not promise you a concession.

**Illuminara**  
I am not asking you to bargain. I am asking what happens on day five.
Chief Engineer Dov Hallam unrolled a section of the plant schematic across the table. He spoke like a man reading a charge sheet against his own drawings.

**Dov Hallam**  
Day five is seventy-four. Below that there is no breach margin. I have a cross-feed from the upper tank farm that would let me seal the upper decks' reserve and let the lower ones go short. I drew it at six this morning because it was the thing I could draw.

**Illuminara**  
Then it is a verdict, not a reserve. Fourteen thousand people live below Nine. They did not set the plants. Seal everyone or seal no one.

**Pell Arkwright**  
The owners will lose four days of throughput if you ration the ore plant to hold the margin for all decks. I am obliged to say so.

**Illuminara**  
Say it and then do it. The cost is real. It is also smaller than a deck that cannot be repressurized.
Dov looked at the cross-feed line, then at her, and rolled it differently, so that the reserve fed all decks to the same floor.

**Dov Hallam**  
Rationing the ore plant by half holds seventy-four for everyone to about day seven. It also frees the power to wake the old scrubber banks on Four through Seven. They need a day and a quarter. The ring will not have its air back before tomorrow noon.

**Illuminara**  
Then someone on Four has a bad night first.

**Dov Hallam**  
Yes. I would rather say it than have you find it.

While they argued the rationing, AC showed her something else. Three lines of dependence ran across the room, from the council, from the owners, from the engineer, and all three ran toward the same place and none of the three looked at it. It was the Registry certificate on the wall behind Dov, off-moon authority, the plant's operating licence.
*A hypothesis. Do not say it as a fact.*

**Illuminara**  
Dov. What does the certificate say about who may run the plant?

**Dov Hallam**  
Registry-certified operators. It says nothing about class. The second-born run it under the contract-labour schedule because the owners filed them there thirty years ago and nobody since has put the question to the Registry.

**Illuminara**  
What does the Registry do with an operator it has certified?

**Dov Hallam**  
Under Article Six, an operator of record is held by the person, not the employer. Name, number, post. The colony can change a worker's census class. It cannot change a record the Registry keeps. Only a finding of cause from the Registry's Review Panel, after a hearing, can remove one.

**Illuminara**  
And the article itself? Who can change that?

**Dov Hallam**  
Two-thirds of the forty member settlements, in open session, after a hundred and eighty days' notice. Six of them run crews like ours on the same schedule. Nobody here has ever filed a single operator under Six. We have never been in it.
Ines Torvald had stopped looking at her papers.

**Ines Torvald**  
If the Registry recorded them, I could not repeal it by resolution.

**Dov Hallam**  
No. And the insurer would not insure a plant whose operators of record were struck off by a colony vote. Pell could not sell a barrel.
Pell Arkwright said nothing, which was an answer.

**Dov Hallam**  
One more thing, since we are being honest. There is an old safety trip on the sequence bus. It forbids sequencing below ninety percent of rating. We bypassed it years ago because it tripped the plant whenever a bearing ran hot.

**Illuminara**  
Keep it. I may want it back.
She turned back to the table, and to the room that had begun, a little, to lean toward the same place.

**Illuminara**  
Then there is a cost to repeal that does not depend on anyone on Calder being kind. I will test whether it is as strong as it sounds. I will test it with the man who has the most reason to doubt it.

scenes.title: The Key and the Throat
paragraphs: *Plant Two Control Room · Day three, 14:00*

Kesh Aurelian was tall in the way that engineered people sometimes were, designed for a height nobody had asked for, and he stood with his back to the sequencing console as if guarding it from her. Hana Duvall, a nurse from the Level Four clinic, had come up with Illuminara. Illuminara had asked for a first-born resident. Hana had asked for the room.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
You have been on my moon for three days and the first thing you do is give the council a way to ration around me.

**Illuminara**  
Yes. And I told you within the hour, because if you had found it yourself on day four, you would never have believed anything I said after.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
You hedged my five days.

**Illuminara**  
I protected the people who were not part of the argument. That is not the same as protecting them from you. It protects them from the arithmetic.
Kesh took that. His hands, at his sides, did not move.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Say what you came to say.

**Illuminara**  
The eight hundred have never been filed as operators of record. The owners put them on the contract-labour schedule, and the council has been able to do to them what a clerk did in the Ninth Year. Refile them under Article Six. Each of you gets a record the Registry keeps off-moon: your name, not a stock number, your post, your contract in your own hand. You can be moved only by a finding of cause after a hearing. And on the console itself, every shift run by two operators, one second-born and one other, and any sequence change needs both keys.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Then I will tell you how they beat it. Tell me where I am wrong. They bring in first-born operators and let ours lapse unused.

**Illuminara**  
A post of record cannot be vacated except by the panel. A cut of more than a tenth of a crew opens a public hearing, a hundred and eighty days.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
The census puts us back to contract stock.

**Illuminara**  
The census is the council's. The record is the Registry's.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Pell sells the plant to someone who does not care.

**Illuminara**  
The licence cannot pass without the operators of record. The buyer takes the eight hundred with the plant, or buys nothing.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
They change the article.

**Illuminara**  
Two-thirds of forty settlements, in open session, after a hundred and eighty days. It can be done. It cannot be done quietly. The Ninth Year took nineteen months of quiet. This would take a year of daylight.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
A year of daylight is still a year. And it is still other people's goodwill.

**Illuminara**  
It is other people's interest. Six settlements stand on the same article. Goodwill has to be asked for. Interest only has to be noticed.
Kesh looked at the console, not at her. It was the first time he had looked away from her since she came in.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Say all of that holds. You still hand me a console with two keys on it. What stops the next Kesh? What stops Jun, or Pell's man, who sits on his key until a bearing fails and says the second-born made him do it? Joint control is a veto in two hands. A hostage needs a hand and a throat. You have given the hands a new throat.

Illuminara did not answer at once. *He is not asking to rule. Watch what he is asking for.* He did not want the chair. He wanted the thing nobody could take back, and he had just found the flaw in her own design faster than she had.

**Illuminara**  
You are right. I built that wrong. A veto over the air is still a lever. So take the lever out of the keys. Dov's old trip, the one that forbids sequencing below ninety percent of rating. We put it back, and the Registry seals it, not the council and not you. The keys never decide whether air flows. They decide only when a maintenance window may open, above the floor, with seventy-two hours' notice posted to every deck.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
And below the floor?

**Illuminara**  
Nothing reaches it. Not a vote, not a key, not two keys, not an order from me. A window may take one train offline for repair, and only while the plant stays at ninety or above. The one way under is to cut the seal by hand. Then every deck's alarm sounds, the Registry duty office is paged, and the interlock re-arms itself and drives the plant back to rating in six hours, whatever anyone does. And any one operator, of any faction, may hold or raise output with no key at all.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Six hours is still six hours.

**Illuminara**  
At two points a day, six hours is half a point. From ninety, seventy-four is eight days away. Nobody can hold a breath hostage on that clock.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Jun withholds his key to stop a repair. The bearing fails. Your floor forbids anyone from commanding below ninety. It does not make dead metal turn.

**Illuminara**  
No. A command rule cannot, and I will not pretend it can. So there are two things under the floor. The first is iron. Plant Two has a fifth train the owners never commissioned for output, a standby that can only stand in for a train that drops out, never lift the plant above rating. When a bearing trips, the interlock starts the standby itself, with no key and no vote. The second is the repair. A bearing reading over the published vibration limit, taken from the Registry-sealed sensor bus and not from anyone's word, lets any single operator of record declare that train failed. No key. The declaration takes that one train offline, calls both crews, and posts to every deck within the hour. It cannot touch another train, it opens nothing without a reading behind it, and it does not open until the standby is carrying the load.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
And if two bearings go in one night?

**Illuminara**  
Then the metal has beaten the paper, and the plant sags whatever any of us signed. The alarms sound, the Registry is paged, and the crews go in on the declaration without waiting for a key. That night is an engineering night. It cannot be turned into a hostage, because nobody's key is on it.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
So Jun's withheld key delays a scheduled repair and nothing else.

**Illuminara**  
Yes. Plant Two runs rough until the published window, or until a measured failure makes the declaration. The cost is a worse week for the engineers, and not a worse week for Level Four. The worst a withheld key can do is nothing. I do not know whether that is enough for you. It is the only kind of safeguard I can see that does not need a better man than you in the chair after you.
Hana had been standing against the wall. She spoke without moving off it.

**Hana Duvall**  
I am not here to be your lever either. I walked up here to tell you that. Level Four read forty-six hundred at midnight, and the dead-end ward past the last vent read nine thousand. For most of us that is a headache. Anselm Pruitt was seventy-one and had two years of lung left. He carried carbon dioxide on a good day. His blood turned acid: seven-twenty-one at two, seven-eighteen at half past three. He died at four this morning. I will not tell you the air alone killed him. Nobody can. It took the last margin he had. We put the nursery in oxygen tents because we had to do something with our hands, and tents do nothing for carbon dioxide.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
I read the list.

**Hana Duvall**  
Then you know the name.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Anselm Pruitt. Yes.

He did not defend it. Illuminara watched him not defend it, and watched the old reflex that said every harm was the fault of those who had made harm necessary rise and die in his throat. He said, quietly, to the room:

**Kesh Aurelian**  
I drew seventy-four for the oxygen. I knew the ring would climb on carbon dioxide before that. I never asked what the dead end would read. I told myself the clinics could carry it for four days. I wrote the word acceptable in my notes. A man's name sits under that word now, beside whatever else was wrong with him.

**Hana Duvall**  
The banks on Four came up at 13:40. The ring is at thirty-nine hundred and falling. That is the first hour in three days I have not had to count breaths. Now you decide what that means.
Kesh did not answer. He stood with his back to the console, and then, slowly, he turned and looked at it.

scenes.title: The Count
paragraphs: *Ballot Hall, Lower Level Seven · Day four, 19:30*

The second-born voted without Kesh in the room. Marit had insisted, and Osei Tamm had agreed, and Kesh had gone and sat in the plant corridor with his arms folded and looked at nothing. Illuminara stood at the back with Wren and held her tongue while eight hundred people raised their hands under the grey lights.
The elders counted. Marit counted twice.

**Osei Tamm**  
Six hundred and twelve for. A hundred and forty-eight against. Forty abstain.

**Teodor Rask**  
I voted against. A record is not a vote. It is a floor under the work, and a name on a shelf off-moon. It is not a door into the house.

**Illuminara**  
You are right. It is standing of record: your name, your post, a hearing before anyone can move you. It is not a seat on the council and I will not call it one. I would rather say that now than have you find it in a year.

**Teodor Rask**  
Then why did you ask us to vote?

**Illuminara**  
Because I do not get to decide for you what is enough. I get to put an honest thing in front of you, and you get to hold it up and see how it looks.

**Marit Voss**  
Then the charter is the door, and this is the floor under the door. Let them sign it. If they break it again, there is still a floor under the broken door.

The Registry duty officer, Sabine Okafor-Reyes, appeared on the relay at 20:10 with the refiling: all eight hundred as operators of record under Article Six, the floor interlock sealed under the Registry's own key, the joint-shift rule written into the plant's certificate as a condition of operation, effective on restoration. Beside her signature stood another.

**Pell Arkwright**  
I am obliged to countersign as licence-holder. I find I am relieved to.

Teodor, who read cryptographic signatures for fun, checked the Registry's key against the refiling on his own console. Kesh called the duty officer on a line the council did not control and listened to her say the same words twice.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
She says the refiling stands whether the council signs the charter or not.

**Illuminara**  
It does. I would not give you anything that needed the council's signature to exist.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Then I stand down first. Before the charter. Before any reward.

**Illuminara**  
That is the order I wanted.

The council did not sign that night. Ines Torvald sent word that she would sign at dawn and not before, as if the hour were hers. Illuminara decided that did not matter. The stand-down was Kesh's to make. The signing was the council's to be seen making. Different currencies.

scenes.title: Seventy-Four
paragraphs: *Scrubber Hall, Plant Two · Day five, 02:40*

Marit and a council engineer named Jun Calloway sat shoulder to shoulder at the sequencing console, each with a key on a chain round the neck, and neither would look at the other. Jun's hands shook. Marit's did not.
Kesh took the open channel and spoke into it the way a man pulls a splinter.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
This is Kesh Aurelian. At 02:41 I release the sequencing on Plant Two. I set the plants to decline. A man named Anselm Pruitt is dead, and my setting took the margin he had left. I will answer to the Registry's inquiry and to the people of Level Four. The air belongs to all of you now. It always did.
He turned the key in his own lock and set it in Marit's palm. Jun turned his. The console accepted the pair, and the Registry's seal came up green on the bus.
The numbers began to climb. Nobody had to turn a key to raise them. Wren read them out softly, as if loud voices might stall them.

**Wren Odira**  
Seventy-six. Seventy-nine. Eighty-two. The tanks are drawing down.

**Marit Voss**  
Hold it there. Let it rise on its own, not on mine or his.

**Jun Calloway**  
I came up here afraid of what you would do with that key.

**Marit Voss**  
I was afraid of the same about yours.

**Jun Calloway**  
I could not lower it now if I tried. Could I?

**Dov Hallam**  
Neither of you could. Not alone, not together. The most anyone can do is cut the seal by hand, and then every alarm on Calder sounds and the interlock climbs back on its own in six hours. That is the point.
Osei Tamm stood at the back of the hall with his arms crossed. He did not look pleased, and Illuminara had not expected him to.

**Osei Tamm**  
A record is not a home. A floor is not a house.

**Illuminara**  
No. It is where you start from, and nobody can pull it out from under you without paying for it in front of six settlements. That is less than you deserve. It is more than you had on Monday. The ballot on Calder is still the council's to give.

**Osei Tamm**  
Hmph. It is a start. I will eat my cap if they keep the second key when the owners change.

**Illuminara**  
The licence cannot pass without you, the Registry will have the owners to deal with, and you will have Marit to ask.
Hana Duvall came down at 03:30 with a thermos and set it on the console without a word, between two keys.

**Hana Duvall**  
Four is at two thousand and falling.
Marit looked at the thermos, and at her, and nodded once. Nothing was forgiven. It was only shared.

By 04:10 Plant Two was at ninety-six percent of rating, the seventy-four line a long way below them, the tanks refilling, and the reserve for every deck on Calder, upper and lower, held to the same floor. The council would sign at dawn. The resentment in the hall would last longer than the signing, and Illuminara did not mind that, because resentment was an honest instrument and it was pointed at something real.

**Marit Voss**  
I wanted my standing without being the hand on the throat. This is the first thing I have held on this plant that cannot hurt anyone.
She leaned back from the console and breathed in, long, as if testing that it was hers.

**Marit Voss**  
Two keys.

**Illuminara**  
Two keys.

critic_line: A second-born plant operator who has learned that recognition can be repealed gives up control of Calder's air only after Illuminara helps build a standing no council can quietly erase and an air floor no withheld key can turn back into a hostage.

literary_score.method: Independent GPT 7D SA1 and Claude PEC-6 v2 final scores; equal 50/50 model weight.
shared_strengths: Both judges found the story's central mechanism specific, causally tested and integral to its moral conflict; the resolution follows from observable constraints rather than assertion.
Both judges praised the distributed agency and the earned positive result: other characters retain consequential choices, costs and limits instead of merely ratifying Illuminara.
shared_reservations: Both judges noted that some dialogue carries dense technical or institutional explanation and that several speakers share an unusually polished register.
Both judges found parts of the solution architecture conspicuously well aligned; the story states real limits, but some supporting characters retain more functional than private texture.

translation_sl.title: ZRAK, KI GA JE DRŽAL DRUGOROJENI
translation_sl.deck: Na rafinerijski luni Calder je osemsto ustvarjenih delavcev brez pravnega statusa nastavilo zračne obrate na počasno upadanje, Illuminara pa mora najti jamstvo, dovolj trdno, da nikomur ne bo treba nikoli več držati diha za talca, in status, ki ga noben svet ne more izglasovati stran.
translation_sl.shape: Pet dni odštevanja; vsak prizor razkrije odvisnost ene strani, dokler zrak ne počiva na vzvodu, ki ga nihče ne more potegniti, status drugorojenih pa na zapisu, ki ga ne hrani nihče na Calderju.

scenes.title: Vrata pod devetico
paragraphs: *Spodnja raven devet, krožna vrata · prvi dan, 06:10*
Wren Odira je prebrala številke s tablice, še preden se je dvigalo povsem odprlo.

**Wren Odira**  
Obrat dve je na dvainosemdesetih odstotkih nazivne zmogljivosti in izgublja dve točki na dan. Kisik iz rezervoarjev pokriva razliko, vendar le do štiriinsedemdeset. Pod tem ni dovolj rezerve, da bi znova vzpostavili tlak na krovu, ki bi ga predrlo.

**Illuminara**  
In česa rezervoarji ne morejo pokriti?

**Wren Odira**  
Rezervoarji proizvajajo kisik. Ne čistijo zraka. Raven štiri je opolnoči pokazala štiri tisoč delcev ogljikovega dioksida na milijon. Običajna vrednost je tisoč petsto.

**Illuminara**  
Kdo živi na štirici?

**Wren Odira**  
Klinika. Vrtec. Stari. To je slepi konec obroča, zato se napolni prvi, zadnji oddelek klinike pa leži za zadnjo zračno režo, kjer se zrak komaj premika.

**Illuminara**  
In obrat ena?

**Wren Odira**  
Enainštirideset odstotkov zraka kolonije, inženirji pa pravijo, da ga ni mogoče potisniti čez devetinštirideset. Obrat dve zagotavlja preostalo in napaja spodnji obroč. Kesh Aurelian določa zaporedje obrata dve. Rekel je peti dan, in pri dveh točkah na dan je peti dan meja.

Hodnik za vrati je bil nizek in topel ter je dišal po vroči kovini in kuhanem žitu. Illuminara je stala v njem in pustila, da je AC naredil, kar je znal. Ni bral misli. Pokazal ji je silnice v prostoru, kakor zemljevid pokaže naklon, in videla je, kako so se ljudje na hodniku nagibali. Vsako telo se je nagibalo proti vratom. To ni bil nagib sovražnosti. Bila je drža ljudi, ki so jim vse življenje govorili, naj čakajo.

*To je odčitek, odčitek pa je ugibanje o ustih nekoga drugega. Preizkusi ga, preden se nanj opreš.* Pri štiriindvajsetih je bila sodna tolmačka. Naučila se je, da prvi pomen vedno prispe z glasom gotovosti.
Ženska v sivem plašču iz hale čistilnikov je stopila iz množice in ji ni ponudila roke.

**Marit Voss**  
Marit Voss. Vodim dnevno izmeno na dvojki. Kesh je rekel, da boste najprej želeli videti njega.

**Illuminara**  
Začeti bi rada s tistim, ki mora dihati odgovor.

**Marit Voss**  
To je napačen odgovor za diplomatko in morda vas bom zaradi njega obdržala. Na tem obratu nas je osemsto. Vodimo ga že od časa, preden se je prvi med nami rodil — vsaj pravno gledano. Nocoj pridite v halo. Spraševali vas bodo. Če boste odgovarjali kakor politik, vam nihče drugič ne odpre teh vrat.

scenes.title: Kaj je vprašala dvorana
paragraphs: *Hala čistilnikov, obrat dve · prvi dan, 20:00*

Sedeli so na vzdrževalnih klopeh med velikanskimi sivimi valji, tristo jih je bilo, ostali so poslušali prek prenosa. Starešina Osei Tamm je imel glas kakor obrabljeno tesnilo in ni vstal, ko je spregovoril.

**Osei Tamm**  
V devetem letu nam je svet dal listino. Priznanje, so temu rekli. Šteli so nas. Dobili smo kartice za obroke z lastnimi imeni. Čez devetnajst mesecev so jo preklicali. Niti glasovanja proti nam niso potrebovali. Uradnik je popisu dodal stolpec in spet smo bili pogodbena lastnina, kartice pa so v menzi nehale delovati. Star sem bil štirideset let. Menze se spominjam.

**Illuminara**  
In od takrat so vsako priznanje uporabili in ga nato vzeli nazaj.

**Osei Tamm**  
Vsako. Ne govorite tega, kakor da ste se naučili iz spisa. Edina stvar na tej luni, ki je ne morejo preklicati, je zrak, ker gre skozi naše roke. To ni politika. To je edino dejstvo, ki ga imamo.

**Marit Voss**  
Vprašaj jo, kar jo hočeš vprašati, Teodor. Ves dan držiš to v sebi.
Mladenič zadaj je vstal. Čez členke je imel brazgotine od dela z ventili.

**Teodor Rask**  
Moja sestra je na ravni štiri. Prvorojeni mož, dojenček. Obroč je kazal štiri tisoč sto, ko sem končal izmeno, in jaz vrtim gumbe, zaradi katerih številke padajo. Ne bom vam rekel, da sem na to ponosen. Če se to konča z otrokom na štirici v šotoru, sem to naredil jaz, to je naredil Kesh, in ne vem, kaj sem, če je cena tega, da sem oseba, prav to.
Nihče ni spregovoril. Marit se je obrnila proti dvorani.

**Marit Voss**  
Nisem vzvod. Hočem, da je to izrečeno pred njo. Hočem svoj status. Nočem, da je kupljen s pljuči nekoga drugega. Če ga lahko dobimo samo tako, da smo roka na grlu, potem so imeli o nas prav in bi raje izgubila.

**Osei Tamm**  
Potem boš izgubila, Marit. Sedi. Oboje je res.
Illuminara je počakala, da je dvorana končala svojo jezo. Nato je povedala, kar je imela, in tega je bilo manj, kot so želeli.

**Illuminara**  
Še ne vem, kako naj vam dam jamstvo, ki ga ni mogoče vzeti nazaj. Vem tri stvari. Vem, da vas ne morem prositi, naj mi zaupate. Vem, da je bil zrak vaš edini vzvod in vaše najtežje breme. In vem, da bom, če ne najdem ničesar, to jasno povedala, vi pa ne boste izgubili ničesar razen dveh dni.

**Osei Tamm**  
Dva dni. To je poštena vsota. Vrnite se, ko boste imeli nekaj, za kar ni potrebno, da ste nam všeč.

scenes.title: Številka za svetom
paragraphs: *Dvorana sveta, zgornji obroč · drugi dan, 09:15*
Predsednica Ines Torvald je govorila odsekano in utrujeno ter prav tako ni vstala.

**Ines Torvald**  
S talci se ne pogajamo. Če se, se naslednja skupina nauči oblike ključa. Poslušala vas bom. Ne bom vam obljubila popuščanja.

**Illuminara**  
Ne prosim vas, da se pogajate. Sprašujem, kaj se zgodi peti dan.
Glavni inženir Dov Hallam je čez mizo razvil del sheme obrata. Govoril je kakor človek, ki bere obtožnico proti lastnim načrtom.

**Dov Hallam**  
Peti dan je štiriinsedemdeset. Pod tem ni več rezerve za predrtje. Imam navzkrižni dovod iz zgornjega skladišča rezervoarjev, s katerim bi lahko zatesnil rezervo zgornjih krovov in pustil spodnje s premalo zraka. Narisal sem ga ob šestih zjutraj, ker je bilo to tisto, kar sem lahko narisal.

**Illuminara**  
Potem je to razsodba, ne rezerva. Pod devetico živi štirinajst tisoč ljudi. Oni niso nastavili obratov. Zatesnite vse ali nikogar.

**Pell Arkwright**  
Lastniki bodo izgubili štiri dni pretoka, če zmanjšate porabo rudnega obrata, da bi obdržali varnostno mejo za vse krove. To sem dolžan povedati.

**Illuminara**  
Povejte in nato storite. Strošek je resničen. Še vedno je manjši od krova, ki ga ni mogoče znova spraviti pod tlak.
Dov je pogledal črto navzkrižnega dovoda, nato njo, in načrt zvil drugače, tako da je rezerva napajala vse krove do iste spodnje meje.

**Dov Hallam**  
Če rudni obrat omejimo na polovico, obdržimo štiriinsedemdeset za vse približno do sedmega dne. S tem sprostimo tudi moč, da prebudimo stare čistilne sklope od četrte do sedme ravni. Potrebujejo dan in četrt. Obroč zraka ne bo dobil nazaj pred jutrišnjim poldnevom.

**Illuminara**  
Torej bo nekdo na štirici prej preživel slabo noč.

**Dov Hallam**  
Da. Raje to povem, kot da bi morali sami odkriti.

Medtem ko so se prepirali o omejitvah, ji je AC pokazal še nekaj. Tri črte odvisnosti so tekle čez sobo, od sveta, od lastnikov in od inženirja, vse tri so vodile na isto mesto, a nobeden od njih ga ni pogledal. To je bilo potrdilo Registra na steni za Dovom, zunajlunska oblast, obratovalna licenca obrata.
*Hipoteza. Ne izreci je kot dejstvo.*

**Illuminara**  
Dov. Kaj pravi potrdilo o tem, kdo sme upravljati obrat?

**Dov Hallam**  
Upravljavci s potrdilom Registra. O razredu ne piše nič. Drugorojeni ga upravljajo po razporedu pogodbene delovne sile, ker so jih lastniki pred tridesetimi leti vpisali tja in od takrat nihče vprašanja ni predložil Registru.

**Illuminara**  
Kaj Register stori z upravljavcem, ki mu je podelil potrdilo?

**Dov Hallam**  
Po šestem členu zapis upravljavca pripada osebi, ne delodajalcu. Ime, številka, delovno mesto. Kolonija lahko delavcu spremeni popisni razred. Ne more spremeniti zapisa, ki ga hrani Register. Odstraniti ga je mogoče le z ugotovitvijo razloga pred preglednim senatom Registra, po zaslišanju.

**Illuminara**  
In sam člen? Kdo ga lahko spremeni?

**Dov Hallam**  
Dve tretjini štiridesetih članic, na javni seji, po sto osemdesetih dneh obvestila. Šest jih vodi posadke, kakršna je naša, po istem razporedu. Nihče tukaj ni še nikoli vpisal niti enega upravljavca po šestem členu. Nikoli nismo bili v njem.
Ines Torvald je nehala gledati svoje papirje.

**Ines Torvald**  
Če bi jih Register zabeležil, tega ne bi mogla preklicati z resolucijo.

**Dov Hallam**  
Ne. In zavarovalnica ne bi zavarovala obrata, katerega upravljavce bi črtovalo glasovanje kolonije. Pell ne bi mogel prodati niti soda.
Pell Arkwright ni rekel ničesar, kar je bil odgovor.

**Dov Hallam**  
Še nekaj, ker smo že iskreni. Na zaporednem vodilu je star varnostni izklop. Prepoveduje zaporedje pod devetdesetimi odstotki nazivne zmogljivosti. Pred leti smo ga obšli, ker je izklapljal obrat vsakič, ko se je segrel ležaj.

**Illuminara**  
Ohranite ga. Morda ga bom hotela nazaj.
Obrnila se je nazaj k mizi in prostoru, ki se je začel vsaj malo nagibati proti istemu mestu.

**Illuminara**  
Potem ima preklic ceno, ki ni odvisna od prijaznosti kogarkoli na Calderju. Preizkusila bom, ali je tako trdna, kot zveni. Preizkusila jo bom z moškim, ki ima največ razlogov, da vanjo dvomi.

scenes.title: Ključ in grlo
paragraphs: *Nadzorna soba obrata dve · tretji dan, 14:00*

Kesh Aurelian je bil visok na način, kakor so bili včasih visoki ustvarjeni ljudje, načrtovan za višino, ki je nihče ni zahteval, in stal je s hrbtom proti konzoli za zaporedje, kakor da jo varuje pred njo. Z Illuminara je prišla Hana Duvall, medicinska sestra iz klinike na ravni štiri. Illuminara je prosila za prvorojeno prebivalko. Hana je prosila za sobo.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Na moji luni ste tri dni in prva stvar, ki jo naredite, je, da svetu omogočite omejiti porabo okoli mene.

**Illuminara**  
Da. In povedala sem vam v eni uri, ker če bi to četrti dan odkrili sami, ne bi nikoli več verjeli ničemur, kar bi rekla pozneje.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Zavarovali ste se pred mojimi petimi dnevi.

**Illuminara**  
Zaščitila sem ljudi, ki niso bili del spora. To ni isto kot zaščititi jih pred vami. Zaščiti jih pred aritmetiko.
Kesh je to sprejel. Njegove roke ob telesu se niso premaknile.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Povejte, kar ste prišli povedat.

**Illuminara**  
Osemsto delavcev ni bilo nikoli vpisanih kot upravljavcev zapisa. Lastniki so jih dali na razpored pogodbene delovne sile in svet je z njimi lahko storil, kar je v devetem letu storil uradnik. Znova jih vpišite po šestem členu. Vsak od vas dobi zapis, ki ga Register hrani zunaj lune: vaše ime, ne inventarne številke, vaše delovno mesto, vašo pogodbo v vaši roki. Premaknejo vas lahko le po ugotovitvi razloga in zaslišanju. Na sami konzoli pa naj vsako izmeno vodita dva upravljavca, en drugorojeni in en drugi, za vsako spremembo zaporedja pa sta potrebna oba ključa.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Potem vam bom povedal, kako to premagajo. Povejte mi, kje se motim. Pripeljejo prvorojene upravljavce in pustijo, da naši zapisi neuporabljeni ugasnejo.

**Illuminara**  
Delovnega mesta zapisa ni mogoče izprazniti drugače kot s senatom. Zmanjšanje posadke za več kot desetino sproži javno zaslišanje in sto osemdeset dni.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Popis nas vrne med pogodbeno lastnino.

**Illuminara**  
Popis je od sveta. Zapis je od Registra.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Pell proda obrat nekomu, ki mu ni mar.

**Illuminara**  
Licence ni mogoče prenesti brez upravljavcev zapisa. Kupec z obratom prevzame vseh osemsto ali pa ne kupi ničesar.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Spremenijo člen.

**Illuminara**  
Dve tretjini štiridesetih naselbin, na javni seji, po sto osemdesetih dneh obvestila. To je mogoče. Ni pa mogoče potiho. Deveto leto je potrebovalo devetnajst mesecev tišine. To bi potrebovalo leto na svetlobi.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Leto na svetlobi je še vedno leto. In še vedno je dobra volja drugih ljudi.

**Illuminara**  
To je interes drugih ljudi. Šest naselbin stoji na istem členu. Za dobro voljo je treba prositi. Interes je treba samo opaziti.
Kesh je pogledal konzolo, ne nje. Prvič, odkar je vstopila, je pogledal stran od nje.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Recimo, da vse to drži. Še vedno mi izročite konzolo z dvema ključema. Kaj ustavi naslednjega Kesha? Kaj ustavi Juna ali Pellovega človeka, ki sedi na svojem ključu, dokler ne odpove ležaj, nato pa reče, da ga je v to prisilil drugorojeni? Skupni nadzor je veto v dveh rokah. Talec potrebuje roko in grlo. Rokam ste dali novo grlo.

Illuminara ni odgovorila takoj. *Ne prosi, da bi vladal. Poglej, za kaj prosi.* Ni hotel stola. Hotel je stvar, ki je nihče ne bi mogel vzeti nazaj, in pravkar je v njeni lastni zasnovi našel napako hitreje kot ona.

**Illuminara**  
Prav imate. To sem zgradila narobe. Veto nad zrakom je še vedno vzvod. Zato vzvod vzemimo iz ključev. Dovov stari izklop, tisti, ki prepoveduje zaporedje pod devetdesetimi odstotki nazivne zmogljivosti. Vrnemo ga, zapečati pa ga Register, ne svet in ne vi. Ključi nikoli ne odločajo, ali zrak teče. Odločajo le, kdaj se sme odpreti vzdrževalno okno, nad spodnjo mejo in z dvainsedemdeseturnim obvestilom na vsakem krovu.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
In pod spodnjo mejo?

**Illuminara**  
Nič je ne doseže. Ne glasovanje, ne ključ, ne dva ključa, ne moj ukaz. Okno lahko zaradi popravila izključi en sklop in samo, če obrat ostane na devetdesetih ali višje. Edina pot pod mejo je ročno prerezati pečat. Tedaj se oglasi alarm na vsakem krovu, dežurna pisarna Registra prejme poziv, zapora pa se sama znova vključi in v šestih urah obrat požene nazaj na nazivno zmogljivost, ne glede na to, kaj stori kdorkoli. In katerikoli upravljavec, iz katerekoli strani, lahko ohrani ali poveča izhod brez vsakršnega ključa.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Šest ur je še vedno šest ur.

**Illuminara**  
Pri dveh točkah na dan je šest ur pol točke. Od devetdeset do štiriinsedemdeset je osem dni. Na tej uri nihče ne more držati diha za talca.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Jun zadrži svoj ključ, da bi ustavil popravilo. Ležaj odpove. Vaša spodnja meja vsakomur prepoveduje ukaz pod devetdeset. Ne more pa prisiliti mrtve kovine, da se vrti.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Ukazno pravilo tega ne zmore in ne bom se pretvarjala, da zmore. Zato sta pod spodnjo mejo dve stvari. Prva je železo. Obrat dve ima peti sklop, ki ga lastniki niso nikoli vključili za izhod, rezervo, ki lahko nadomesti samo sklop, ki izpade, nikoli pa ne more dvigniti obrata nad nazivno zmogljivost. Ko ležaj sproži izklop, zapora sama zažene rezervo, brez ključa in glasovanja. Druga stvar je popravilo. Odčitek ležaja nad objavljeno mejo vibracij, zajet z vodila tipal, ki ga je zapečatil Register, ne po besedi kogarkoli, omogoči kateremukoli posameznemu upravljavcu zapisa, da ta sklop razglasi za odpovedan. Brez ključa. Razglasitev izključi samo ta sklop, pokliče obe posadki in v eni uri objavi obvestilo na vsakem krovu. Ne more se dotakniti drugega sklopa, brez odčitka za seboj ne odpre ničesar in ne začne veljati, dokler rezerva ne prevzame bremena.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
In če v eni noči odpovesta dva ležaja?

**Illuminara**  
Potem je kovina premagala papir in obrat upade ne glede na to, kaj je kdo med nami podpisal. Alarmi se oglasijo, Register dobi poziv in posadke vstopijo na podlagi razglasitve, ne da bi čakale na ključ. Tista noč je inženirska noč. Ni je mogoče spremeniti v talca, ker na njej ni ključa nikogar.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Torej Junov zadržani ključ odloži načrtovano popravilo in nič drugega.

**Illuminara**  
Da. Obrat dve teče grobo do objavljenega okna ali dokler izmerjena odpoved ne sproži razglasitve. Cena je slabši teden za inženirje, ne slabši teden za raven štiri. Najhujše, kar lahko naredi zadržani ključ, je nič. Ne vem, ali vam to zadostuje. To je edina vrsta varovala, ki jo vidim in ki ne potrebuje boljšega človeka od vas na stolu za vami.
Hana je stala ob steni. Spregovorila je, ne da bi se od nje odmaknila.

**Hana Duvall**  
Tudi jaz nisem tukaj, da bi bila vaš vzvod. Prišla sem gor, da vam to povem. Raven štiri je opolnoči pokazala štiri tisoč šeststo, oddelek v slepem koncu za zadnjo zračno režo pa devet tisoč. Za večino od nas je to glavobol. Anselm Pruitt je imel enainsedemdeset let in dve leti pljuč pred seboj. Že na dober dan je zadrževal ogljikov dioksid. Njegova kri je postala kisla: sedem enaindvajset ob dveh, sedem osemnajst ob pol štirih. Umrl je danes ob štirih zjutraj. Ne bom vam rekla, da ga je ubil samo zrak. Tega ne more nihče. Vzel mu je zadnjo rezervo, ki jo je še imel. Vrtec smo dali v kisikove šotore, ker smo morali nekaj storiti z rokami, šotori pa za ogljikov dioksid ne naredijo ničesar.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Prebral sem seznam.

**Hana Duvall**  
Potem poznate ime.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Anselm Pruitt. Da.

Ni ga branil. Illuminara ga je opazovala, kako ga ne brani, in opazovala stari refleks, ki je govoril, da je vsaka škoda krivda tistih, zaradi katerih je bila škoda nujna, kako se mu je dvignil v grlu in umrl. Tiho je rekel prostoru:

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Za kisik sem določil štiriinsedemdeset. Vedel sem, da bo obroč zaradi ogljikovega dioksida narasel prej. Nikoli nisem vprašal, koliko bo pokazal slepi konec. Dopovedoval sem si, da lahko klinike to nosijo štiri dni. V zapiske sem napisal besedo sprejemljivo. Pod to besedo zdaj stoji ime človeka, poleg vsega drugega, kar je bilo z njim narobe.

**Hana Duvall**  
Sklopi na štirici so se zagnali ob 13:40. Obroč je na tri tisoč devetsto in pada. To je prva ura v treh dneh, ko mi ni bilo treba šteti vdihov. Zdaj se vi odločite, kaj to pomeni.
Kesh ni odgovoril. Stal je s hrbtom proti konzoli, nato pa se je počasi obrnil in jo pogledal.

scenes.title: Štetje
paragraphs: *Volilna dvorana, spodnja raven sedem · četrti dan, 19:30*

Drugorojeni so glasovali brez Kesha v prostoru. Marit je vztrajala, Osei Tamm se je strinjal, Kesh pa je odšel in sedel na hodniku obrata s prekrižanimi rokami ter gledal v nič. Illuminara je stala zadaj z Wren in molčala, medtem ko je osemsto ljudi pod sivimi lučmi dvignilo roke.
Starešine so prešteli. Marit je štela dvakrat.

**Osei Tamm**  
Šeststo dvanajst za. Sto oseminštirideset proti. Štirideset vzdržanih.

**Teodor Rask**  
Glasoval sem proti. Zapis ni glas. Je tla pod delom in ime na polici zunaj lune. Ni vrata v hišo.

**Illuminara**  
Prav imate. To je status zapisa: vaše ime, vaše delovno mesto, zaslišanje, preden vas lahko kdorkoli premakne. Ni sedež v svetu in ne bom ga tako imenovala. Raje to povem zdaj, kot da bi vi čez leto odkrili.

**Teodor Rask**  
Zakaj ste nas potem prosili, naj glasujemo?

**Illuminara**  
Ker jaz ne odločam namesto vas, kaj je dovolj. Pred vas lahko postavim pošteno stvar, vi pa jo lahko dvignete in pogledate, kako je videti.

**Marit Voss**  
Potem so listina vrata, to pa so tla pod vrati. Naj jo podpišejo. Če jo znova zlomijo, bodo pod razbitimi vrati še vedno tla.

Dežurna uradnica Registra Sabine Okafor-Reyes se je ob 20:10 pojavila na prenosu z novim vpisom: vseh osemsto kot upravljavci zapisa po šestem členu, zapora spodnje meje zapečatena z lastnim ključem Registra, pravilo skupne izmene vpisano v potrdilo obrata kot pogoj delovanja, z začetkom veljavnosti ob obnovitvi. Ob njenem podpisu je stal še en.

**Pell Arkwright**  
Kot imetnik licence sem dolžan sopodpisati. Ugotavljam, da sem olajšan.

Teodor, ki je za zabavo preverjal kriptografske podpise, je na lastni konzoli primerjal ključ Registra z novim vpisom. Kesh je dežurno uradnico poklical po liniji, ki je svet ni nadzoroval, in poslušal, kako je iste besede dvakrat ponovila.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Pravi, da novi vpis velja ne glede na to, ali svet podpiše listino.

**Illuminara**  
Velja. Ne bi vam dala ničesar, kar bi za svoj obstoj potrebovalo podpis sveta.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Potem najprej odstopim. Pred listino. Pred vsako nagrado.

**Illuminara**  
Takšen vrstni red sem želela.

Svet tisto noč ni podpisal. Ines Torvald je poslala sporočilo, da bo podpisala ob zori in nič prej, kakor da je ura njena. Illuminara se je odločila, da to ni pomembno. Odstop je moral izbrati Kesh. Podpis sveta je moral svet opraviti pred očmi vseh. Različni valuti.

scenes.title: Štiriinsedemdeset
paragraphs: *Hala čistilnikov, obrat dve · peti dan, 02:40*

Marit in svetov inženir po imenu Jun Calloway sta sedela z ramo ob rami pri konzoli za zaporedje, vsak s ključem na verižici okoli vratu, in nobeden ni hotel pogledati drugega. Junove roke so se tresle. Maritine se niso.
Kesh je odprl javni kanal in spregovoril vanj tako, kakor človek izvleče trn.

**Kesh Aurelian**  
Tukaj Kesh Aurelian. Ob 02:41 sproščam zaporedje obrata dve. Jaz sem nastavil upadanje obratov. Človek z imenom Anselm Pruitt je mrtev in moja nastavitev mu je vzela preostalo rezervo. Odgovarjal bom preiskavi Registra in ljudem ravni štiri. Zrak zdaj pripada vsem vam. Vedno vam je.
Ključ je obrnil v lastni ključavnici in ga položil v Maritino dlan. Jun je obrnil svojega. Konzola je sprejela par, pečat Registra na vodilu pa je zasvetil zeleno.
Številke so začele rasti. Nikomur ni bilo treba obrniti ključa, da bi jih dvignil. Wren jih je tiho brala, kakor da bi jih glasni glasovi lahko ustavili.

**Wren Odira**  
Šestinsedemdeset. Devetinsedemdeset. Dvainosemdeset. Rezervoarji se praznijo.

**Marit Voss**  
Držite tam. Naj raste samo, ne po moji ali njegovi volji.

**Jun Calloway**  
Sem gor sem prišel v strahu, kaj boste naredili s tem ključem.

**Marit Voss**  
Enako me je bilo strah vašega.

**Jun Calloway**  
Zdaj ga ne bi mogel znižati, tudi če bi poskusil. Kajne?

**Dov Hallam**  
Nobeden od vaju ne bi mogel. Ne sam, ne skupaj. Največ, kar lahko kdorkoli stori, je ročno prerezati pečat, tedaj pa se oglasi vsak alarm na Calderju in zapora se v šestih urah sama povzpne nazaj. To je bistvo.
Osei Tamm je stal zadaj v hali s prekrižanimi rokami. Ni bil videti zadovoljen in Illuminara tega ni pričakovala.

**Osei Tamm**  
Zapis ni dom. Tla niso hiša.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. So mesto, od koder začnete, in nihče vam jih ne more potegniti izpod nog, ne da bi to plačal pred šestimi naselbinami. To je manj, kot si zaslužite. Je več, kot ste imeli v ponedeljek. Glasovnica na Calderju je še vedno v rokah sveta.

**Osei Tamm**  
Hm. To je začetek. Pojedel bom svojo čepico, če ob menjavi lastnikov obdržijo drugi ključ.

**Illuminara**  
Licence ni mogoče prenesti brez vas, Register bo imel opravka z lastniki, vi pa boste lahko vprašali Marit.
Hana Duvall je ob 03:30 prišla dol s termovko in jo brez besede postavila na konzolo med dva ključa.

**Hana Duvall**  
Štirica je na dva tisoč in pada.
Marit je pogledala termovko, nato njo, in enkrat pokimala. Nič ni bilo odpuščeno. Samo deljeno je bilo.

Ob 04:10 je bil obrat dve na šestindevetdesetih odstotkih nazivne zmogljivosti, meja štiriinsedemdeset daleč pod njimi, rezervoarji so se polnili, rezerva za vsak krov na Calderju, zgornji in spodnji, pa je držala isto spodnjo mejo. Svet bo podpisal ob zori. Zamera v hali bo trajala dlje od podpisa in Illuminaro to ni motilo, ker je bila zamera pošten instrument, usmerjen v nekaj resničnega.

**Marit Voss**  
Hotela sem svoj status, ne da bi bila roka na grlu. To je prva stvar, ki jo držim v tem obratu in ne more nikomur škodovati.
Odmaknila se je od konzole in globoko vdihnila, kakor da preverja, ali je dih njen.

**Marit Voss**  
Dva ključa.

**Illuminara**  
Dva ključa.

translation_sl.critic_line: Drugorojeni upravljavec obrata, ki se je naučil, da je priznanje mogoče preklicati, se nadzoru nad Calderjevim zrakom odpove šele, ko Illuminara pomaga ustvariti status, ki ga noben svet ne more potiho izbrisati, in spodnjo mejo zraka, ki je noben zadržani ključ ne more znova spremeniti v talca.
